priorStories.headline: COP31 ends without an overarching climate agreement
priorStories.body:
The UN climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye, closed Sunday without consensus on an overarching agreement. The European Union and other delegations rejected the proposed outcome amid disagreements over fossil-fuel transition language and climate finance.

UN climate chief Simon Stiell confirmed that the presidency-led decisions had not won agreement. Separate negotiating decisions, including on a just transition, were adopted, so the breakdown did not mean that all conference decisions failed.

sources.name: UN Framework Convention on Climate Change

priorStories.headline: Delta system outage disrupts flights across U.S.
priorStories.body:
A failure of Delta Air Lines’ automated aircraft weight-and-balance system disrupted flights nationwide Sunday. Delta said the system was restored during the afternoon, but delays continued into the evening. Employees used manual calculations while the automation was unavailable.

The FAA briefly restricted Delta flights bound for Atlanta and said its own air-traffic systems were not responsible. At 9 p.m. Eastern, FlightAware data showed that more than half of all flights at Atlanta’s airport had experienced delays. Weather also contributed to the disruptions; that figure does not measure the outage’s effects alone.

candidates.summary: The Democratic National Committee announced its framework for the 2028 presidential primary debates on November 23. It plans 12 debates, five in 2027 and seven in 2028, beginning in June 2027. Candidates must sign and follow a Fair Campaign Practices Pledge committing to denounce dark-money spending in the primary to qualify. Polling and other support requirements will also apply; specific qualification criteria for the first two debates are due in January 2027.
candidates.title: DNC announces 2028 debate framework and dark-money pledge requirement

candidates.summary: On November 23, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Ukrainian forces used seven naval drones to sink the Russian corvette Merkury at Benghazi, Libya, in an attack on November 22. He also said a Russian military helicopter was destroyed and the Russian cargo ship MV Angara was hit. Libya's eastern-based government confirmed that the corvette had been struck at the naval base in a suspected drone attack. Russia's Defence Ministry had not immediately commented. The target-day development is Ukraine's public attribution and claims about the previous day's operation, not a newly occurring attack.
candidates.title: Zelenskiy claims Ukrainian responsibility for Russian warship attack in Libya

candidates.summary: Nvidia announced on November 23 that Jensen Huang had been reinstated as president, chief executive and a director following a unanimous board vote. Its SEC filing dates the reinstatement decision and immediate effectiveness to November 22; the target-day development is the public announcement. Colette Kress remains chief financial officer and Harvey Jones remains board chair. The company said its independent investigation into reports concerning a foreign intelligence effort targeting Huang would continue, as would cooperation with government investigations and inquiries.
candidates.title: Nvidia announces Jensen Huang's reinstatement as chief executive

candidates.summary: Ukrainian officials said on November 23 that the death toll from the previous day's Russian attack on an apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv region, had reached 11. Rescuers pulled a seven-year-old boy and a 79-year-old woman alive from the rubble, Reuters reported, citing officials. Search operations continued. These are casualty and rescue updates concerning the November 22 strike, not a new November 23 attack.
candidates.title: Dymer strike death toll reaches 11 as rescuers recover survivors

candidates.summary: President Emmanuel Macron announced on November 23 that France was earmarking €350 million in state support for civil aviation research during a visit to an Airbus plant in Toulouse. Reuters reported that the funding would come under France's Civil Aeronautics Research Council. The announcement formed part of the Choose France summit focused on domestic corporate investment; it does not establish that the research funds have already been disbursed.
candidates.title: Macron announces €350 million for civil aviation research
